name: Knott's Fireman's BBQ St. Louis Style Smoked Pork Ribs (Mild BBQ)
whyItWorks: Wood-smoked pork spareribs cooked until the meat pulls clean from the bone. Glazed with mild sweet barbecue sauce and served with soft white bread.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pork Ribs platter with white bread and mashed potatoes; request mild BBQ sauce on the side.
